shots.x: The hall, full. Rukmī announces the match in front of the whole household, pleased with himself.

shots.dlg: Rukmī: Chedi gives us a border. The cowherd would give us a cousin.
shots.te: చేది మనకు సరిహద్దు ఇస్తుంది. ఆ గొల్లవాడు ఇచ్చేది ఒక బంధుత్వం మాత్రమే.

shots.x: Bhīṣmaka looks down. He loves his son, and the whole room can see it.
Rukmini watches her father not look up. She does not cry.
She answers her brother without raising her voice, and the camera moves in on the last four words.
shots.dlg: Rukmini: You can give away a kingdom, brother. Not a woman who has already chosen.
shots.te: రాజ్యాన్ని ఇచ్చేయగలవు అన్నయ్యా. ఇప్పటికే నిర్ణయించుకున్న ఆడదాన్ని కాదు.
